title: Hermes Agent alternatives: self-run or hosted?
h1: hermes agent alternatives when upkeep is the question
description: Compare Hermes Agent's open source, desktop and Nous cloud options with Metal, including the sign-in limits stated in Hermes' provider docs.
answer: **keep hermes if you want to change the code. pick dusk if you want to brief a teammate.** hermes has mit-licensed code, persistent memory, self-created skills and configurable subagents. it already has desktop apps and cloud hosting on paid nous portal plans. dusk gives named bots separate jobs in an app. compare the ai sign-in rules before comparing monthly bills.[^1][^2][^3]

review.by: lead agent: read against seo/facts, automated gate, independent fact-check pass

og_line: open code and hosting are separate choices.

them: **you want to change the code.** mit licensing, persistent memory and self-created skills matter to your work.
**you want configurable helpers and chat channels.** paid nous portal plans also offer a cloud agent.
dusk: **you want to give bots jobs in plain words.** name a few teammates in an app.
**you want dusk to look after the machine.** choose a hosted computer with daily backups, or keep bots on your own.

compare.h: self-run is one hermes path, not all of them
compare.intro: **you can buy hosting on either side.** tiers and sign-in limits below are as of 12 november 2026. read the current provider terms before choosing a connection.

method:
**compare the upkeep and sign-in bill before moving.** Metal is based on Dusk Bot. we read the saved hermes homepage, readme and provider docs against dusk docs on 12 november 2026.

we did not run matching jobs, measure minimum hardware or test isolation strength. use this comparison to choose a trial, then judge the result yourself.

sections.h: keep hermes if the code matters
sections.md:
**choose hermes when changing the code for work is part of the job.** its mit license lets you do that.[^4] dusk is source-available under polyform noncommercial: you can change it and pass it on for noncommercial use only. work needs a license.[^5]

hermes also has persistent memory, self-created skills and configurable subagents.[^1] if those are why you use it, an easier screenshot is a weak reason to move. compare [openclaw and hermes](/vs/openclaw-vs-hermes-agent) for another open project.

sections.h: find the bill behind the sign-in
sections.md:
**claude max can leave you paying for extra usage.** hermes lists chatgpt/codex sign-in. its anthropic route needs claude max and bills purchased extra usage, outside the base max allowance. claude pro cannot use that route.[^2]

dusk runs vendors' own command-line apps. you sign in yourself on the bot's machine.[^11] read current terms, supported sign-ins and usage limits before scheduling work. a working sign-in does not make every use permitted.

**pay for hosting when you want your evenings back.** as of 12 november 2026, nous portal plus costs $20 monthly, super $100 and ultra $200. paid tiers include a cloud agent.[^1]

dusk cloud includes a computer we look after and back up daily. ai usage stays on your provider's bill.[^6][^9] you still choose the jobs and permissions. start app reviews read only.[^12]

compare [homes for an always-on agent](/agents-when-laptop-closed) if missed routines are the pain. the [openclaw alternatives](/alternatives/openclaw) cover other ways to package an assistant.

faq.q: do i have to run hermes agent myself?
faq.a: **no. hosting is already an option.** paid nous portal plans include a cloud agent. you can also use your own machine or server, with a desktop app or terminal install.[^1]

faq.q: can hermes connect to the ai i already sign in to?
faq.a: **some sign-ins work, with different limits.** chatgpt/codex is listed. anthropic requires claude max with purchased extra usage; base usage and claude pro don't count. read current terms before budgeting.[^2]

faq.q: can i make a group chat of agents?
faq.a: **choose the interaction you want.** hermes has isolated subagents for parallel work. dusk has shared chats with mentions and an optional leader. those are different ways to hand work around.[^1][^8]
